nodes.Name: stkframe
nodes.DocComment: A stkframe holds information about a single physical stack frame.

Fields.Name: lr
Fields.DocComment: program counter at caller aka link register

Fields.Name: fp
Fields.DocComment: stack pointer at caller aka frame pointer

nodes.Name: reflectMethodValue
nodes.DocComment:
reflectMethodValue is a partial duplicate of reflect.makeFuncImpl
and reflect.methodValue.

Fields.Name: stack
Fields.DocComment: ptrmap for both args and results

nodes.Name: argBytes
nodes.DocComment: argBytes returns the argument frame size for a call to frame.fn.

nodes.Name: argMapInternal
nodes.DocComment:
argMapInternal is used internally by stkframe to fetch special
argument maps.

argMap.n is always populated with the size of the argument map.

argMap.bytedata is only populated for dynamic argument maps (used
by reflect). If the caller requires the argument map, it should use
this if non-nil, and otherwise fetch the argument map using the
current PC.

hasReflectStackObj indicates that this frame also has a reflect
function stack object, which the caller must synthesize.

nodes.Name: getStackMap
nodes.DocComment:
getStackMap returns the locals and arguments live pointer maps, and
stack object list for frame.

Children.Name: if
Children.RawSource: (GOARCH == "amd64" || GOARCH == "arm64" || GOARCH == "loong64" || GOARCH == "ppc64" || GOARCH == "ppc64le" || GOARCH == "riscv64" || GOARCH == "s390x") && unsafe.Sizeof(abi.RegArgs{}) > 0 && isReflect
